blocks.text: Langley City homes listed and sold, June to September 2026

Langley City, September 2026. Detached houses: 64 listed at month end and 8 sold in September, a sales ratio of 13% (a balanced market). Condos and townhomes: 195 listed at month end and 34 sold in September, a sales ratio of 17% (a balanced market).

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 37 sold over 4 months against an average of 69.8 listed, about 7.5 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 12 sold. Condos and townhomes: 106 sold over 4 months against an average of 194.0 listed, about 7.3 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was September with 34 sold.

faq.q: How did Langley City sell in September 2026?
faq.a: The Langley City sub-area recorded 64 detached listings with 8 sold (13%) and 195 Condos & Townhomes listings with 34 sold (17%, joint with Aldergrove in the Langley set); no City-only median is published — the combined Langley community medians (detached $1,345,000; attached $611,000) blend in the Township and are not City figures (as of September 2026, Source: SnapStats FVR/GVR September 2026 report).

faq.q: What are Langley City's secondary suite rules?
faq.a: Under Zoning Bylaw 2025 No. 3300, a suite must not exceed the lesser of 100 m² and 40% of the building's gross floor area, the registered owner must reside on the lot, at least one extra off-street parking space is required, and the suite must be permitted, inspected and recorded in the City's secondary suites registry (~/workspace/area-research-2026-11/rules-gaps-2026-11-01.md, read 2026-11-01).

faq.q: How many homes are for sale in Langley City?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 64 houses listed with 8 sold in the month and 195 condos and townhomes listed with 34 sold in the month in Langley City. Those are month-end counts and move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Langley City a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026, houses had a sales ratio of 13%, a balanced market; condos and townhomes had a sales ratio of 17%, a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.
